name: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead) — Advanced — Walk the Road of Shadows

system.description:
The second of the Telyavelic Tremere's two Sielanic Thaumaturgical Paths (the source text's original title for this Path is illegible in the surviving copy, and "Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead" is an editorial label rather than a confirmed canon name), it uses the caster's own unliving body as a conduit for contact with the world of the dead. At its highest levels the sorcerer can touch the essence of Telyavel, the Lithuanian death-god, himself. Like its sister Path, it disappears with the Telyavelic bloodline's extinction, though rumor holds some of its principles were subsumed into Dark Thaumaturgy and other infernal Disciplines.

The caster physically crosses the Shroud into the Underworld for a brief span, appearing to its denizens as a particularly solid wraith. She can interact freely with the dead there, though she has no control over how they regard her, and any combat that erupts inflicts real damage on both her and her wraithly foes. Sielanic priests sometimes use this power to lead mortals into the Underworld as part of a shamanic initiation rite.

System: A single success lets the caster penetrate the Shroud and enter the Underworld; three successes let her bring one companion along. She may remain until dawn forces her out, until she flees, or until the dead drive her out. This power does not allow travel deeper into the Underworld once there.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
